data.name: Joramiel
data.gender_notes: Joramiel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Joramiel is derived from two roots: ‘YHWH’ (God) and ‘Ramah’ (height or exalted). This name can be translated as ‘God of Thunder’ or ‘Exalted God’. In the Bible, there is no character by this name, but it is found in Jewish folklore where Joramiel is the angel of thunder. The name Joramiel carries the meaning “God of Thunder” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Joramiel usually hope their child will grow to embody god of thunder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, power, and divine intervention in times of turmoil and storms.
data.etymology: Joramiel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Thunder.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Joramiel total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: יורמיאל
in_hebrew.meaning: יורמיאל הוא שם שפירושו אלוהים הוא מרם
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יורמיאל הוא שם עברי שמורכב משתי מילים: 'יור' שפירושו אלוהים הוא מרם, ו-'מיאל' שפירושו מי אלוהים. השם יורמיאל הוא שם שמשמעו אלוהים הוא מרם או אלוהים הוא השופט שלי. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים והיהודים כאחד, והוא נחשב לשם חזק ומשמעותי.

in_greek.name: Ιωραμiel
in_greek.meaning: Ιωραμiel σημαίνει ο Θεός είναι ο ύψιστος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ιωραμiel είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει ο Θεός είναι ο ύψιστος ή ο Θεός είναι ο κρίστης μου. Το όνομα αυτό έχει βρει χρήση στην Εκκλησία και είναι γνωστό για την πνευματική του σημασία.

in_latin.name: Joramiel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Joramiel derivatur ex lingua hebraica et significat Deus est eximius vel Deus est judex meus. Hoc nomen in usu est apud Christianos et habetur pro nomine valido et significativo.

in_english.name: Joramiel
in_english.meaning: God is exalted or God is my judge
in_english.long_meaning: The name Joramiel originates from Hebrew roots, 'Yoram' meaning God is exalted and 'El' meaning God. It signifies God is exalted or God is my judge. This name holds spiritual significance in Christian tradition, symbolizing a strong connection with God and divine guidance.

celebrity_usage: Joramiel is a name used by J.K. Rowling for a character in her Harry Potter series.
data.cultural_impact: Joramiel holds significant importance in the folklore and mythology of Jewish cultures as an angel of thunder. In mystical texts and Jewish legends, he is believed to 'call' or 'summon' the thunderstorms. The belief in storm gods, including Joramiel, has been an integral part of various cultures for centuries. This belief can be traced back to ancient civilizations, including the Egyptians, Greeks, and Norse, who revered storm deities.
data.spiritual_significance: Joramiel can serve as a reminder of the power and glory of God. The name highlights His ability to control the forces of nature, such as thunderstorms. It can be an inspiration for individuals to recognize and appreciate the awe-inspiring power of God in their lives. Joramiel also symbolizes the idea that God is above all, and He holds the power to exalt us in times of difficulty or need. Through this name, one can be motivated to seek God's guidance, protection, and strength in their personal spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Joramiel: God of healing and restoration. His name means "God of the height of God." He is believed to bring hope and renewed energy to those seeking healing from physical or emotional wounds.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Joramiel is mentioned in the apocryphal Book of Enoch as one of the archangels. The name Joramiel carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

trends: Use as a given name for boys
modern_usage.modern_context: Joramiel is a name of Hebrew origin, derived from the Hebrew words 'Yoram' (mountain of God) and 'El' (God). It is considered a variant of the name Joram. In modern usage, Joramiel is used as a given name for boys, and can be found on various social media platforms and baby name websites.

name_in_real_life.story: Peter Joramiel, a minister in Dublin, Ireland, shares that their name Joramiel meaning "God of Thunder" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
